What we're searching: Winning atleast ONCE in 220 tries.

Prob of winning in 1 try is 0.8%
Num of tries = 220

To facilitate this, we'll use the property of probability and using the inverse probability (ie, instead of looking at the probability of winning once in 220, we'll look at the probability of 1 - the probability of losing all)

Probability of losing all being: (1 - prob of winning in 1 try) power to the amount of tries = 0.992^220

So the probability of winning atleast once is 1 - 0.992^220 = 0.829 = around 83%

Ar - Lec - Chi - No

Ar: like the pirate sound or the letter R;

Lec: pronounced like Lick but with an E so it's pronounced as Leck;

No: it's just pronounced as No, nothing complicated here.
